narrative.summary: Upgrades need 7 of 15 signers and group admin actions only 5 of 17, both with no delay, and the upgrade voters are a subset of the admin group. The score is still an upper bound.
narrative.tag: upper bound: 7 more admin fields not decoded
narrative.detail: Program upgrade is a Squads v4 multisig, 7-of-15, all 15 can vote, no delay. MarginfiGroup.admin is a different Squads v4 multisig, 5-of-17 (15 listed members can vote), also no delay. All 15 upgrade voters sit inside the admin multisig, so this is one governing body under a lower bar, not two independent checks. The on-chain IDL lists seven more admin-named fields on the group (emode_admin, risk_admin and five others) that were not decoded, and each could only lower the score. Oracle authority is not scored for this target (a flat 100 in code).

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it
